eyebrow: Retry and Catch on a Task state
code:
RunGlueJob:
  Type: Task
  Retry:
    - ErrorEquals: [States.TaskFailed]
      IntervalSeconds: 30
      MaxAttempts: 3
      BackoffRate: 2.0
  Catch:
    - ErrorEquals: [States.ALL]
      Next: NotifyFailure
caption: Retry absorbs transient errors; Catch is the fallback once retries are exhausted.

steps.label: ErrorEquals
steps.sub: which error types this rule applies to

steps.label: IntervalSeconds
steps.sub: wait before the first retry attempt

steps.label: MaxAttempts
steps.sub: caps how many times it retries

steps.label: Runs after retries exhaust
steps.sub: or immediately if no Retry is set

steps.label: Routes to a Next state
steps.sub: log, alert, or clean up instead of dying silently
